description: Single common scale factor applied to the thickness biomarkers of both export formats (the four pachymetric biomarkers of group A and all group B biomarkers) after the refraction correction of the uncorrected sections; group C is not scaled (Section 2.6). The factor was derived from a comparison of raw mask thicknesses with the ANTERION outputs in 27 eyes of the device-agreement sample (Section 2.7). The classification does not depend on the factor (Section 2.7; classification/scale_invariance.py).
availability: The numerical value of the factor is not distributed with this repository and is available from the authors on request. Enter it under "factor" before running measurement/build_feature_table.py or classification/sensitivity_bowman.py.
format_rule: wide if the exported DICOM has >= 1500 columns, otherwise narrow (Table S1); the export type, with or without refraction correction, is determined from the image itself (segmentation/preprocessing.py)
